title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 13: how the priest examines skin diseases, the life of a leper, and mildew in garments.

questions.text: To whom must a man with a possible plague of leprosy be brought?
questions.explanation: He shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.

answers.text: To Moses at the Tent of Meeting
To the elders at the city gate
To a physician in the camp
To Aaron the priest or one of his sons

questions.text: Which two signs show the priest that a spot is the plague of leprosy?
questions.explanation: If the hair in the plague has turned white and it appears deeper than the skin, it is the plague of leprosy.

answers.text: It itches and feels warm when it is touched
The hair has turned white and it is deeper than the skin
It is round and has black hair growing in it
It is flat and fades when it is in the sun

questions.text: What does the priest do with a white spot that is not deeper than the skin and whose hair has not turned white?
questions.explanation: In that case the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.

answers.text: Pronounce him unclean at once
Send him out of the camp for good
Isolate the person for seven days
Burn his clothes

questions.text: If leprosy covers all the skin from head to feet and has all turned white, what does the priest pronounce?
questions.explanation: If the leprosy has covered all his flesh and it has all turned white, the priest pronounces him clean.

answers.text: That he is clean
That he must stay outside the camp
That he must be isolated for a month
That his house must be destroyed

questions.text: What kind of hair in a plague on the head or beard shows it is leprosy?
questions.explanation: If it appears deeper than the skin and the hair in it is yellow and thin, it is an itch, leprosy of the head or the beard.

answers.text: Thick black hair
Long curly hair
Yellow and thin hair
No hair at all

questions.text: What shows that an itch on the head or beard is healed?
questions.explanation: If the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it, the itch is healed and he is clean.

answers.text: Black hair has grown in it
The skin has become rough
It has spread to the beard
Yellow hair has appeared

questions.text: What is said about a man whose hair has fallen from his head?
questions.explanation: If a man's hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.

answers.text: He is a leper and unclean
He is bald, and he is clean
He must be isolated seven days
He must shave his beard

questions.text: What must a leper cry out?
questions.explanation: The leper shall wear torn clothes, let his hair hang loose, cover his upper lip and cry, 'Unclean! Unclean!'

answers.text: "Have mercy! Have mercy!"
"Keep away! Keep away!"
"Holy! Holy!"
"Unclean! Unclean!"

questions.text: What colors in a garment or leather show the plague that must be shown to the priest?
questions.explanation: If the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment or leather, it is the plague of leprosy and must be shown to the priest.

answers.text: Black or brown
Blue or purple
Greenish or reddish
Yellow or gray

questions.text: What is done with a garment when the plague has spread in it after seven days?
questions.explanation: If it has spread, it is a destructive mildew; the priest shall burn the garment in the fire.

answers.text: It is washed once and worn again
It is burned in the fire
It is given to a stranger
It is buried in the ground
